QuestInfo.name: The Girl Who Knows Luminous
QuestInfo.0: According to Athena's information, Ellinia's great magician Grendel saw Luminous recently. Ask Grendel the Really Old about Luminous and his whereabouts.
QuestInfo.1: Not even the great magician Grendel exactly knows where Luminous is. Instead, he told you about a girl who comes to borrow books every day who lives with Luminous. You might be able to meet Luminous through Lania. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.2: Not even the great magician Grendel exactly knows where Luminous is. Instead, he told you about a girl who comes to borrow books every day who lives with Luminous. You might be able to meet Luminous through Lania.

0.0: If you don't want to become a magician, what brought you here? You want to find Luminous? Oh, I hope this isn't about some world-threatening doom again...
0.1: If it's personal business, I won't ask. Besides, I don't know where he lives either. However, I know a girl who lives with him. It's about time for her to drop by... Do you want to meet her?

yes.0: Ah, there she is, right on time. She comes here to borrow a book every day. See if she'll help you.

no.0: I know nothing more about Luminous than what that girl tells me. I only know that he lives near Ellinia.

npc.0: That girl is the only way to reach Luminous. I can only help you this much.
